description: An Ed25519 public key with a torsion component that is not of small order (Wycheproof ed25519_test.json tcId 160's key 15deb307…b2c23b, flag MixedOrderPublicKey) is rejected at import by policy (ADR 0043 §1, amending ADR 0026 §6 and ADR 0041 §4; RFC 8037 §2). Derived independently of polyjose with RFC 8032 §5.1 arithmetic in pure Python: the key decodes canonically (§5.1.3), [8]P is not the identity, and [L]P is a point of order 8
